title: PatientSummary
description: Source-preserving rollup. Extraction confidence is not clinical verification. v2.2 adds demographics.performance_status_verbatim[] (required, may be empty): performance-status wording exactly as written, never converted between scales. Legacy schema_version "2" / "2.1" archives are read leniently by validate_structured_outputs.py (WARN, not FAIL).

alias.description: Optional user-chosen non-clinical label; do not embed diagnosis or identifiers.

demographics.description: Only sex is time-invariant. Age, anthropometrics and ECOG are point-in-time observations: each scalar carries its own `_as_of` source date, and differing values across different `_as_of` dates are normal evolution, NOT a source conflict.

age.description: Age as stated by the MOST RECENT source that states one — a snapshot, not a current age. Never recompute it to today; downstream renders it together with `age_as_of`. Null when no source states an age.

age_as_of.description: Report/collection date of the source that `age` was taken from. Required whenever `age` is non-null; an age without this anchor is meaningless and must not be written.

age_observations.description: Every source-stated age with its own date, oldest first. Values differing across dates are the expected time series, not a conflict — see organizer-prompt-phase2-synthesis.md §2.1.

birth_year.description: Year of birth only (YYYY), `system_normalized`, written ONLY when a source states a full DOB or an age+date pair that pins it. Full DOB is never stored (quasi-identifier, see pii-rescan-prompt.md). Lets downstream render an approximate current age instead of a stale snapshot; the ±1-year ambiguity is intentional and must be surfaced as 约/approx.

height_cm_as_of.description: Source date of `height_cm`. Required whenever `height_cm` is non-null.

weight_kg.description: Most recent source-stated weight. Serial weights belong in longitudinal_observations.json (`obs_type: vital`); this is the latest snapshot only.

weight_kg_as_of.description: Source date of `weight_kg`. Required whenever `weight_kg` is non-null.

ecog_as_of.description: Source date of `ecog`. Required whenever `ecog` is non-null. A later ECOG differing from an earlier one is a change in status, not a disputed value.

function_description.description: Clinician wording only: a clinician document's own description of function (e.g. 生活可自理), verbatim on a line of a source demographics.source_refs cites (never a conversation: anchor or a 14_患者自管补充 sidecar); null when no clinician source states one. Never converted to ECOG. A patient/caregiver self-description of function is NOT written here: it stays on its patient_reported / caregiver_reported surface (a timeline self-report event), organizer-prompt-phase2-synthesis.md §5.7.

performance_status_verbatim.description: Every performance-status statement as written (PS=1, ECOG 2, KPS 80 …) with its date and the scale label the source prints, oldest first. Never converted between scales; `ecog` stays null unless a clinician source literally writes ECOG. profile.json.demographics carries the same list.

longitudinal_observations_ref.description: Neutral observations, not a response trajectory.

extraction_confidence.description: Technical extraction confidence only; not diagnostic confidence.

value.description: Age exactly as stated by that source; never recomputed.

age_basis.description: Only when the source says so (周岁 / 虚岁). Never inferred — an unlabelled age is `unspecified`, and unspecified ages are compared with ±1 tolerance.

text.description: Verbatim wording, e.g. PS=1 (bound to the cited line; an ellipsis-only quote is rejected).

as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the source that states it; null only when that source is undated.

scale_label.description: The scale label the source itself prints; unlabeled when it prints none. Never inferred.

provenance_layer.description: Optional; absent = the demographics block's layer. prior_archive for a statement restated from a prior-archive digest (history only — never the current performance status); it must then cite the digest.
prior_archive = restated from a prior_archive_digest source (earlier organize archive, original not in this packet); history only, never current status.
